name: Domenico Francesco Prostamo
note: Naturalised 1 October 1962 while living at 38 Park Terrace, Sherwood — the Commonwealth Gazette of 10 January 1963 carries him. He lies in plot 608, beside plot 607. BIRTH DATE CORRECTED 15 SEPTEMBER: this row read 1931. Brisbane City Council's own record gives 18 OCTOBER 1930, which agrees with the family tree's 1930 and makes him ninety-four at death rather than ninety-three.

name: Maria Assunta Prostamo, born Melluso
note: Plot 607, beside her husband in 608. Daughter of Gregorio Melluso and Carmela Maria Borello. Naturalised 4 July 1966 from 3 Frank Street, Graceville. THE DATES DISAGREE BY THREE DAYS: the Queensland death index registers the event on 27 October 1991, Find a Grave gives 30 October. Both are recorded; neither is corrected.

name: Angela Majda Prostamo
note: The Commonwealth Gazette of 16 November 1961 naturalised an Angela Prostamo. Same name, right decade, untested.

name: Rocco Prostamo
note: A MELBOURNE BRANCH, entirely new to this archive, which had the Prostamo going only to Brisbane and Buenos Aires.

name: Francesca Prostamo
note: Buried in the same Melbourne cemetery as Rocco. Carried twice on Find a Grave, once with dates and once without.

name: Gregorio Melluso
note: Maria Assunta's father. Son of GENNARO MELLUSO and MARIA LIMARDO — the Queensland death index names both. Mareeba is the tobacco country of the far north, and the registration is coded C for a country event, which agrees. Limardo is a Potenzoni surname, which places this Melluso household in the Briatico district.

name: Rocco Melluso
note: Plot 3231, beside 3232. A Sydney Melluso couple. No join to this family shown; carried because the surname is rare in Australia.

name: Mario Mazza
note: A LEAD, NOT A JOIN. Buried in the SAME PLOT as Maria Mazza — Mon 3H 104 — which in these registers means a married pair, the rule that found the four Mazza grandparents lying in a row at Nudgee. Neither is in Michael's export: it holds no Mazza born 1921 or 1931. Mario died at ninety-three. Whether this is a branch of the Piedimonte Etneo Mazza who reached Brisbane, or an unrelated Sicilian family of the same very common name, NO RECORD READ SO FAR SAYS. The Queensland death index would name his parents and settle it.

name: Maria Mazza
note: Mario Mazza's wife, by the shared plot. Died at eighty-two. See the line above: a lead, and not yet a join.
